sources.title: Majestic Metro Station — Purple-Green Line Interchange
sources.usageNote: Page text only, for corroborating connectivity/interchange facts. Not an official BMRCL source; treated as a secondary corroboration, not primary evidence.

referenceNotes: Supported by sources: underground interchange between Purple and Green Lines (the network's only such interchange), busiest station in the network (200,000+ daily passengers), built cut-and-cover at approximately 80 feet (~24m) depth, 4 tracks across 2 platform levels with a rake interchange between the two lines, adjacent to Kempegowda Bus Station and KSR Railway Station.

NOT supported, and not claimed as accurate: exact concourse layout, finish materials, signage design, or precise dimensions of the interchange walkway. These are architecturally reasonable given a deep cut-and-cover interchange, not verified detail.

Renderer limitation, disclosed rather than hidden: the real station stacks the Purple and Green Line platforms on separate levels linked by a rake interchange; the shared layout engine only supports side-by-side platform modules at one level, so the second level is suggested only via a lit mezzanine slab above the tunnel, not modelled as an actual second platform.
No image files were downloaded, scraped, or embedded — this dataset stores link-only pointers to publicly viewable pages, gathered by reading their text content.
